Description: Occurs when detecting that the response field is not matched with the Auto CMD12 or Auto CMD23 response error of the CMD_wo_DAT. CMD12 errors are indicated in D04-D01. This register is valid only when the Auto CMD Error Status Enable bit is set to 1. This bit will be set to 1 when Auto CMD12 Error is generated by Auto CMD23.

Field Name: Command Not Issued By Auto CMD12 Error
Description: Setting this bit to 1 means CMD_wo_DAT is not executed due to an Auto CMD12 Error (D04-D01) in this register. This bit is set to 0 when Auto CMD Error is generated by Auto CMD23.
Occurs if the command index error occurs in response to a command.
Occurs when detecting that the end bit of command response is 0.
Occurs when detecting a CRC error in the command response.
Occurs if no response is returned within 64 SDCLK cycles from the end bit of the command. If this bit is set to 1 the other error status bits (D04-D02) are meaningless.

If memory multiple block data transfer is not started due to a command error the bit is not set because it is not necessary to issue an Auto CMD12. Setting this bit to 1 means the Host Controller cannot issue the Auto CMD12 to stop memory multiple block data transfer due to some error. This bit is set to 0 when Auto CMD Error is generated by Auto CMD23.
